newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria budget deficit up to 298 bln lvs March 31.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria budget deficit up to 298 bln lvs March 31.

text.p: Bulgaria's central government budget deficit rose by 58 billion levs in the second half of March to 298 billion levs, preliminary Finance Ministry figures showed.
"The budget deficit was 298 billion levs at end-March ," a Finance ministry official told Reuters.
The rise in the deficit was mainly due to payments on Bulgaria's large domestic debt, the official said.
The Finance ministry made a total of 68.827 billion levs interest and discount payments on government securities in the second half of March, Finance ministry figures showed.
The debt increased to 2,778 billion levs at end-February from 1,053 billion levs at end-1996 due to the sharp lev fall and new government securities issued to finance the budget gap.

The deficit at end-March was around 1.43 percent of the nominal Gross Domestic Product (GDP) for 1997 assumed in a funding arrangement between the interim government and the International Monetary Fund (IMF) sealed in March.
The budget deficit for 1997 was assumed at 3.8 percent of projected nominal GDP set at 20.743 trillion levs, down a real 4.8 percent from 1996.

Figures for spending, revenue and deficit as percentage of budget targets are not available because a viable budget for 1997 has yet to be passed by the new parliament due to assemble after April 19 elections.
